one_line: Meta's Marketing API (Graph API endpoints) for creating and managing ads across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
auth_notes: OAuth2 via a Meta app with Marketing API / Ads Management permissions. Requires a Meta developer account, Business Manager, and Ad account. App review + advanced access required for production marketing permissions.
self_serve_notes: Self-serve: create a Meta app free, use test ad accounts immediately; production access needs app review to add marketing permissions (advanced access).

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, audiences, insights, custom conversions, catalogs, Business Management; tens of Graph API endpoints
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for asynchronous ad review/status updates and conversion events

existing_mcp.note: No official Meta MCP for Marketing API; community MCP servers exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text (2KB) confirms Marketing API scope and related APIs; auth/self-serve from Meta docs

agent_notes: App review for advanced access is the friction point; test ad accounts enable sandbox calls immediately.
